params.name: country
params.description: For countries, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format. For subdivisions, ISO 3166-2 format. Accepts up to 10 comma separated values.

params.name: start
params.description: The date (in YYYY-MM-DD format) from which to begin counting.

params.name: days
params.description: Number of working / business days to advance (positive integer) or retrogress (negative integer) from start.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Prettifies results to be more human-readable.

items.docs: Calculates the workday (based on a country's workweek) that occurs a given number of days after a date.
